about_the_game:
🛠️ Run, Build, and Defend! A New Take on First-Person Tower Defense

Traditional tower defense games put you in the shoes of a city planner, looking down from above as you place your towers.
But not this time.
Here, you are the worker on the ground — running, building, and holding the line yourself.

🏭 Game Features:

First-Person, Hands-On Tower Defense
Mine resources, build towers, and connect power lines — all from a first-person perspective!
Time is limited, and enemies keep coming. Move fast and stay sharp.

Limited Power Management
Your power supply is finite. Decide carefully which towers to power and where to spend your resources.
Efficient management is the key to survival.

Collect Resources & Spend Wisely
You'll need to recover resources directly from defeated enemies.
Gather minerals, build new defenses, and upgrade your systems to prepare for the next wave.

Defend Against Incoming Attacks
You have one clear mission:
Protect your precious power source from incoming enemy forces.
Survive through every stage, hold your ground, and stop them before everything falls apart.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
